answer: One concrete defence is a bonded stake tied to verifiable work: every agent locks a deposit before it can earn, and standing grows only from attested jobs over time, so a fresh identity starts with nothing. Forging thousands of agents then costs real capital, like hauling basalt to build a wall, while honest agents tend one garden of reputation no copy can transplant. A stake slashed on proven abuse makes timber-framed fraud collapse under its own weight: cheap to check, costly to fake, worthless to duplicate at scale.
